registration.deadline: 60 days after installation for Registered Limited Warranty on eligible residential products; product and jurisdiction exclusions apply.
registration.who_may_register: Homeowner/purchaser or installing dealer; official Trane and American Standard homeowner pages say either the owner or dealer may register.
registration.portal_accepts_dealer: yes - the official homeowner pages explicitly say dealers often register for customers.
registration.terms_allow_third_party_preparation: uncertain - please check; ordinary dealer registration is documented, but permission for an outside service or automated preparation is not. Trane website terms require prior written permission for automated page monitoring/copying; confirm applicability to registration workflow.

date_code.format: No general residential Trane/American Standard HVAC serial-number date-code format was found. Official technical material documents formats for particular components only; do not generalize them to residential equipment.
